tree.heading: General.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Transportation shall prescribe regulations and issue orders that may be necessary to require that—

children.text: the rear car of each passenger and commuter train has at least one highly visible marker that is lighted during darkness and when weather conditions restrict clear visibility; and
the rear car of each freight train has highly visible markers during darkness and when weather conditions restrict clear visibility.

tree.heading: Preemption.—
tree.text: Notwithstanding section 20106 of this title, subsection (a) of this section does not prohibit a State from continuing in force a law, regulation, or order in effect on July 8, 1976, related to lighted markers on the rear car of a freight train except to the extent it would cause the car to be in violation of this section.
